blocks.text: CEBU CITY — In front of Spikers’ Turf’s biggest crowd in history with 13,180 fans, Alpha Insurance outlasted the revamped Savouge, 25-22, 19-25, 26-24, 22-25, 16-14, to kick off its Invitational Conference campaign on a high note on Saturday at SM Seaside Cebu Arena. With the Protectors on the verge of a meltdown, Alpha fought back from a 10-12 deficit after Axel Van Book’s back-to-back kills and a costly attack error by Kyle Villamor to reach match point at 14-13. Mark Calado forced a deuce with an off-the-block hit for Savouge, but Dan Nicolas sent his serve into the net to […]...
